findings.title: totalDeltaB() getter sums only BEAN_ETH_WELL, not all minting wells
findings.description: SeasonGettersFacet.totalDeltaB() is documented as 'Returns the total Delta B across all whitelisted minting liquidity Wells' but its body computes deltaB = LibWellMinting.check(C.BEAN_ETH_WELL) — a single hardcoded well. The protocol's actual season-minting path, Oracle.stepOracle() (Oracle.sol#21-27), instead iterates LibWhitelistedTokens.getWhitelistedWellLpTokens() and accumulates LibWellMinting.capture() over EVERY whitelisted well: `for (i) deltaB = deltaB.add(LibWellMinting.capture(tokens[i]))`. LibDeltaB.overallCurrentDeltaB() (LibDeltaB.sol#54-60) likewise sums all wells. The protocol is explicitly multi-well: both C.BEAN_ETH_WELL and C.BEAN_WSTETH_WELL are migrated/whitelisted (ReseedL2Migration.sol#35-40, mock inits set isWhitelistedWell + stalkEarnedPerSeason for BEAN_WSTETH). Therefore once BEAN_WSTETH (or any second well) holds liquidity, the value returned by totalDeltaB() is NOT the protocol's aggregate peg deviation — it omits every well except BEAN_ETH. The function name and NatSpec assert an aggregate ('total ... across all') that the implementation does not deliver. This is a behavioral/semantic divergence between the documented protocol-level invariant (this getter reports the figure that drives mint/burn) and the actual code.
findings.impact: Off-chain consumers, dashboards, keeper/MEV bots, and any integrating contract that reads totalDeltaB() to gauge whether Beanstalk is above or below peg receive a value that ignores all non-BEAN_ETH wells. In a multi-well deployment this can report the protocol at peg (or above) when the true aggregate deltaB (the quantity that stepSun mints/burns on) is materially different, leading to mispriced soil/pod decisions by integrators and misreporting of protocol solvency state. No on-chain Beanstalk consumer of totalDeltaB() was found (stepOracle recomputes the correct sum independently for minting), so there is no direct fund loss inside Beanstalk; the impact is incorrect public protocol state reporting and downstream integrator/keeper miscalculation. Severity is capped at Low because the minting math itself is unaffected and no trusted on-chain consumer reads this getter.
findings.proof_of_concept: 1. Two wells whitelisted as minting wells: BEAN_ETH (deltaB = +1000) and BEAN_WSTETH (deltaB = -3000). 2. Oracle.stepOracle() (used by sunrise) returns -2000 and the protocol acts below peg (sets soil = 2000). 3. A caller reads SeasonGettersFacet.totalDeltaB() and gets +1000 (BEAN_ETH only), concluding the protocol is above peg. 4. The on-chain mint/soil action (-2000, below peg) contradicts the value the getter reported (+1000). Assertion: totalDeltaB() != sum over getWhitelistedWellLpTokens() of LibWellMinting.check(well) whenever any whitelisted minting well other than BEAN_ETH has nonzero twaDeltaB.
findings.invariant_violated: totalDeltaB == sum of twaDeltaB over all whitelisted minting wells (the quantity stepSun acts on)

ite.intent: An integrator or keeper relying on Beanstalk's public peg-deviation getter mis-reads the protocol's aggregate deltaB, causing them to act on a single-well figure while the protocol mints/burns on the multi-well sum.
ite.technique: Call SeasonGettersFacet.totalDeltaB() (SeasonGettersFacet.sol#96-98); it returns LibWellMinting.check(C.BEAN_ETH_WELL) only. Compare against Oracle.stepOracle() (Oracle.sol#21-27) which sums LibWellMinting.capture() over getWhitelistedWellLpTokens(); the two diverge whenever a second minting well (BEAN_WSTETH per ReseedL2Migration.sol#40) carries nonzero deltaB.
ite.evasion: The developer intended totalDeltaB() to mirror the protocol's aggregate minting input (NatSpec: 'total Delta B across all whitelisted minting liquidity Wells'); the gap is a hardcoded single well constant where a loop over getWhitelistedWellLpTokens() was required.

ice_chain.consumer_function: (no on-chain Beanstalk consumer; off-chain integrators / keepers / dashboards)
ice_chain.consumer_action: reads protocol-wide peg deviation to make soil/pod/peg decisions off-chain

bsa_metadata.stated_intent: Returns the total Delta B across all whitelisted minting liquidity Wells.
bsa_metadata.actual_behavior: Returns the twaDeltaB of only C.BEAN_ETH_WELL; ignores every other whitelisted minting well (e.g. BEAN_WSTETH).

critical_assumptions: At least one whitelisted minting well other than BEAN_ETH (e.g. BEAN_WSTETH) holds liquidity and carries nonzero twaDeltaB.
findings.confidence_note: Source-traced end to end: getter body, stepOracle loop, LibDeltaB.overallCurrentDeltaB loop, and the multi-well whitelist/migration all confirmed in source.
